newsitem.title: UK: Nationalising Colombian oil not on agenda - minister.
newsitem.headline: Nationalising Colombian oil not on agenda - minister.

text.p: Nationalisation of Colombia's oil industry is not on the agenda in government talks with rebel groups, Colombia's Minister of Mines and Energy Rodrigo Villamizar said on Monday.
"We have said officially that the oil policy is not part of any discussions... between the government and guerilla groups," he told Reuters in an interview here.

His comments follow an Interior Ministry move to open talks with leftist rebels who have been waging a long war of economic sabotage on oil and coal installations, demanding nationalisation of the oil industry.

"There has been a dialogue... and the Ministry of Interior has said they are open to listen to any initiatives from the guerilla groups. But the pieces of legislation introduced by groups which are supported by leftist or radical groups, in which they suggest the nationalisation of the oil industry, is considered to only represent these minority groups and the chance of this going through congress is almost nil," Villamizar said.
